name: hollal-platform
install: cd hollal-platform && composer install --no-interaction && (test -f .env || cp .env.example .env) && if [ -n "${ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then grep -q '^ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD=' .env && sed -i "s|^ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD=.*|ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD=${ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD}|" .env || echo "ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD=${ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD}" >> .env; fi && sed -i 's/^SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE=true/SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE=false/' .env && php artisan key:generate --force && touch database/database.sqlite && php artisan migrate --force --no-interaction && php artisan db:seed --force --no-interaction
